thread:
sam: Vendor update - ACME only shipped 8/12 racks for the A100 dedicated pool in eu-west1. Need a manual allocation for the weekend canary. Who can take point on a temporary slot bump + quick fallback plan? @maria any PO / ETA updates?

riley: I can take it. Need a temporary +4 GPU boost for tenant 'demo-team' until Monday. What's the one-liner to do this from infra?

sam: Use infractl, e.g. `infractl alloc --tenant demo-team --gpu 4 --pool eu-west1-a100-temp --ttl 48h` — that creates a temporary carve we can auto-revoke.

maria: pinged vendor rep (cc @riley). Vendor now saying full shipment Tue (their timezone). Sending PO follow-up and asking for expedited freight. :mailbox_with_mail:

devops-bot: Created ticket INF-4721: manual alloc for demo-team (assignee: riley)

riley: preflight check: quotas before alloc -> run `gcloud compute reservations list --project=infra-prod --regions=europe-west1` and `gcloud compute quotas describe --region=europe-west1` ; current GPU usage 18/20. I'll drain one nonprod slot to free the 4 needed.

nate: note — draining will trigger autoscaler cooldowns for that tenant. When you reassign, pass `--force` to infractl to skip a couple of waiting hooks for kv-cache migration. Also remember to clear kv-cache TTLs after the canary.

riley: plan: 1) cordon & drain tenant 'spike-tests' 2) infractl alloc +4 3) run smoke 50 req/s for 10m 4) revert allocation and uncordon. ETA ~45m. Starting now.

sam: awesome. If anything blocks escalate to @oncall-eng. :thumbsup:

riley: drain done, infractl alloc executed, smoke test passed (50 req/s, p95 latency within SLO). Reverted allocation and uncordoned 'spike-tests'. Left runbook notes in INF-4721.

maria: PO update: vendor acknowledged expedited freight, but final racks still show Tuesday arrival. I asked for a partial manifest so we can plan rack-to-tenant mapping.

sam: great work, thanks everyone. Leaving INF-4721 open until vendor delivery confirmed. Closing this channel thread for the immediate weekend need.
